newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 3 T-bill issues worth 15 bln levs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 3 T-bill issues worth 15 bln levs.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed three special T-bill issues with maturity between 30 and 44 days and worth a total of 15.03 billion levs, the central bank said.

Two of the issues were discount ones, the third bears a floater coupon equal to the central bank's main interest rate for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 16.50 percent monthly or 198 percent annually.
In line with its usual practice the central bank did not say with which financial intitution or institutions the issues were placed on Wednesday.
Details of issues follow. Prices are in percent of par.
Par value 4,200 million levs 5,380 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 29.23 pct 18.98 pct
